answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. This means an attacker must choose: either run a few high-quality identities, or many worthless ones — and neither option beats honest participation.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a lotus as the anchor of the cost.
